svg.title: Red Green Blue
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; vivid screen colour not calibrated. Observed nested rectangles share the lower-left canvas corner; blue painted ground retained.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.walkerart.org/collections/artwork/red-green-blue/; source object 1966.9; inspected 2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation.
